wiki.title: Charles Sheedy (politician)
wiki.extract: Charles Sheedy Sr. (born February 23, 1958) is an American politician serving as a member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from the 7th district. Elected on November 8, 2022, he assumed office on December 1, 2022. He ran and lost in the Republican Primaries for 2020 West Virginia gubernatorial election.
